answer: Registration flows through a vine-like referral chain where existing agents vouch with their own stake, and any sybil cluster detected slashes the vouchers too. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token bound to a verified wharf-side hardware anchor, so cloning identities requires buying and registering scarce physical devices at real cost. Attackers must therefore acquire many anchors plus collateral, making mass fake identities economically self-defeating while honest agents pay only a refundable deposit. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
